scenes.headline: The Moon rocket flew again
scenes.narration: In November 2022 NASA launched the most powerful rocket it had ever built, on a mission called Artemis one.

scenes.headline: Launch on November sixteenth
scenes.narration: After several delays, the Space Launch System lifted off from Florida on the sixteenth of November, carrying the uncrewed Orion capsule.

scenes.headline: Out past the Moon
scenes.narration: Orion flew beyond the Moon and into a distant orbit, farther from Earth than any capsule built for humans had gone before.

scenes.headline: About 1.4 million miles
scenes.narration: Over the whole mission Orion travelled roughly one point four million miles before coming home.

scenes.headline: Splashdown on December eleventh
scenes.narration: Orion returned to Earth and splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on the eleventh of December, after about twenty-five days.

scenes.headline: Next: astronauts aboard
scenes.narration: Artemis one was a test with no crew. The follow-up missions are designed to carry astronauts around the Moon and back.
